Elsa ~ 628

Sines increase, Earth shall sway, Trumpets shall sound.
Alice and Bob with Eve they have found,
Ana & Graham hide in the shrouds,
Of past memories in the seas, they had drowned.

Bob & Alice; lovers entwined,
By the stars had aligned.
Eve had schemes
On how to break their dreams.

Stealing their notes,
Rewriting their hopes,
Eve tore the seams.

Alice & Bob agreed on a key,
To carry on their legacies,
With their silent sighs,
Bob had muttered "Circumferences shed on 2 Pi"
